findings.title: Reconcile execution-plane instructions
findings.evidence: AGENTS.md forbids all Droplet editing; EXECUTION_BOUNDARIES.md explicitly allows one edit-only worker. CONTRIBUTING.md directs local automated checks.
findings.recommended_change: Make one canonical execution matrix; point startup and contribution instructions at it. Preserve Actions-only automated project validation. Reconcile one-worker legacy wording with accepted Platform-v2 bounded concurrency.
findings.acceptance: A fresh agent receives one unambiguous permitted editing/validation surface; docs do not change live host policy by implication.

findings.title: Remove contradictory phase routing
findings.evidence: PROGRAM_ROADMAP says Phase 1 PRIMARY_ACTIVE; Sep-11 reconciliation says Phase 1 complete for transition and Phase 2 primary; #1063 approves Phase 2.5 after DR-70.
findings.recommended_change: Consolidate effective phase state and supersession precedence in a bounded source-bound reconciliation.
findings.acceptance: No route resurrects HS-03/HS-04 or skips Phase 2.5; DR-70 remains a prerequisite for its activation.

findings.title: Retire pre-reset executable task wording
findings.evidence: PROGRAM_PROGRESSION task still instructs preservation of pre-reset channel geomorphology and dressing repair; latest reset changes geometry authority.
findings.recommended_change: Replace obsolete objective/gate text together with projection fingerprints and intentional state migration; preserve accepted completions and active claims.
findings.acceptance: Shadow selection cannot dispatch H6 repair or invalidate live work silently; mismatched source hashes fail closed.

findings.title: Replace stale startup and lane frontiers
findings.evidence: Bootstrap/Authorship ledgers stop at F2B/F2C while main includes F4H/F4J; Cross-Lane snapshot still lists old morphology and MUS-0002 recovery gates.
findings.recommended_change: Maintain one compact current frontier with source SHA, evidence level, current issue, owner, next unmet criterion; move history below it.
findings.acceptance: Fresh reconstruction identifies implemented versus exercised versus human-accepted capabilities without rereading dozens of PRs.

findings.title: Verify current controller ownership through Platform-v2
findings.evidence: Issue #349 has recent status requests but sampled latest status output is legacy Sep-18 state; bootstrap's zero-claims assertion is not a live observation.
findings.recommended_change: Use authenticated canonical development-state read with capture time, runtime SHA and claims; do not infer empty ownership from an old issue.
findings.acceptance: One current ownership snapshot precedes dispatch; missing access yields WAIT_AUTHORITY for conflicting edits, not a new worker.

findings.title: Make atmosphere work durable
findings.evidence: The atmosphere task reports a local #1180 port; shared directory has unborn master/no remote and all source untracked. Three atmosphere PRs remain open.
findings.recommended_change: Preserve local bytes; select one surviving #1180 branch after comparison and ownership check, then publish its bounded delta and CI. Do not overwrite the shared folder.
findings.acceptance: One issue/claim/PR contains the intended port; exact head Actions evidence and deferred analysis are linked.

findings.title: Reduce duplicate and historical active work surfaces
findings.evidence: 17 open PRs were observed, including duplicate atmosphere attempts, #1172, and old audit/dependency proposals; #1032 and #489 are explicitly preserved evidence.
findings.recommended_change: Classify each as active, blocked, superseded, preserved evidence or dependency refresh; choose one survivor per task; close only with owner authority and a successor pointer.
findings.acceptance: No duplicate task can be claimed; #1032/#489 and H6/aircraft archives remain intact; no blanket stale-branch deletion.

findings.title: Connect the authorization to the actual water write path
findings.evidence: SurfaceStage stores hydrologyAuthorization but all four applyAvailable calls use the two-argument legacy overload; installAuthorizedHydrology has no caller in the snapshot.
findings.recommended_change: Route the intended production/review binding through a single gated dispatch point; preserve explicitly isolated legacy diagnostics.
findings.acceptance: Behavioral test installs an authorization and proves out-of-plan writes are zero at every lifecycle entry; normal runtime cannot silently bypass the token.

findings.title: Separate terrain-cut authorization from water authorization
findings.evidence: allowsHydrologyPosition accepts the entire original solid Y interval for every qualified terrain column; F4G retains an unchanged bank-infeasible water component. Filtered writes still originate in the legacy planner.
findings.recommended_change: Represent solved water volume/head and per-component water eligibility explicitly; discretize that plan rather than intersecting legacy water with a terrain-cut envelope.
findings.acceptance: Bank-infeasible component remains dry; water cells match solved bed/head/connectivity/containment, and no cell is permitted solely because its terrain column qualified.

findings.title: Bind refined fields to their exact solved provenance
findings.evidence: fromF4H accepts an arbitrary SkyIslandQualifiedFluvialTerrainField; projection checks candidate descriptor but not refined-field identity. Field construction accepts arbitrary original terrain and reaches.
findings.recommended_change: Carry a validated immutable refinement result identifying association, original field, candidate, solver/qualification and component decisions; reject mismatch at the boundary.
findings.acceptance: Negative tests reject substituted fields sharing reach IDs, changed terrain, wrong association and unqualified refinement; no claim that a public factory alone prevents all mismatch.

findings.title: Prove runtime realization rather than projection-only readiness
findings.evidence: QualifiedFluvialVoxelRemovalProjection enumerates positions and explicitly does not mutate; only test call sites were found. New seam existence does not prove lifecycle use.
findings.recommended_change: Complete one exact-association runtime consumer and its mutation ordering, replay, fluid ownership, save/reload and reopen evidence before the next visual packet.
findings.acceptance: Actions produces a fresh reset specimen that demonstrably uses the new path; rejected components perform zero mutations and repeated/reopened work is inert.

findings.title: Preserve incomplete hydrology classes explicitly
findings.evidence: F4G supports one solved ordinary component in 8/81/77; the other is bank-blocked. POND/LAKE calibration has zero supported candidates in reported sweeps; former primary/confluence/lake controls remain zero-authority.
findings.recommended_change: Use a capability matrix with positive, negative and deferred classes; finish transitions/calibration only under #1084 authority. Do not label ordinary-only proof complete hydrology.
findings.acceptance: Each promised DR-70 class has accepted machine evidence and human disposition, or the director explicitly records a scoped deferral; no relaxed threshold merely to turn a control green.

findings.title: Replace blind candidate sweeps with a causal calibration experiment
findings.evidence: Reported additional 10,240-island sweep found no POND/LAKE support; continuing identical searches has low demonstrated value.
findings.recommended_change: Trace classifier preconditions and distributions, define a justified expanded domain or a separately reviewed semantic correction; keep thresholds frozen until calibrated.
findings.acceptance: Experiment records hypothesis, sampled domain, class yield and stop rule; no hidden classifier widening or favorable-seed cherry-picking.

findings.title: Close the terrain/population ordering race
findings.evidence: #1092 describes schedule-dependent tree attachments; baseline catch-up service gates surface population on the current chunk, not stable terrain for the relevant admitted volume; #1093 remains open.
findings.recommended_change: Review/recompose the existing narrow lifecycle repair, preserve no-force-loading, and explicitly handle volumes with unloaded pending terrain without permanent starvation.
findings.acceptance: Targeted readiness tests plus Windows DR-50 A/B prove stable population outcome and unchanged owned/native boundaries; no digest removal.

findings.title: Resolve the production A4MC dependency boundary
findings.evidence: #1142 records accepted engineering seam in a patch; stock 0.2.1 lacks it and remains inert. Upstream #18 is the external dependency.
findings.recommended_change: Track upstream delivery; if unavailable when production convergence needs it, director chooses a maintained fork/vendor policy. Pin source, patch and output identities.
findings.acceptance: Chosen production artifact passes same-coordinate terrain A/B, no duplicate atmosphere, bounded no-load queries and reconstruction evidence.

findings.title: Finish consumer-effect diagnosis before tuning
findings.evidence: #1180 reports imperceptible glider lift and repeated hawk descent despite accepted atmosphere authority.
findings.recommended_change: Finish disabled/enabled glider and hawk A/B using the same real field, deterministic starts, entity-ticking regions and ordinary-terrain controls; classify stock versus adapter behavior.
findings.acceptance: Report trajectory deltas, provenance, hawk departures, SOAR/steering and removal outcomes; tuning is a separate justified change with human feel review.

findings.title: Distinguish proof-stack capability from shipped-stack capability
findings.evidence: A4MC R&D override is explicit; alpha baseline policy requires intentional support of every selected dependency.
findings.recommended_change: Produce a capability/dependency roster with CORE/INTEGRATED/CANDIDATE/OPTIONAL/REJECTED/DEFERRED, exact artifacts, adapter owner and user-facing surfaces.
findings.acceptance: Every shipped surface is integrated, intentionally disabled or documented optional; no R&D override masquerades as stock production behavior.

findings.title: Prove first-flight resource closure beyond nonzero opportunity
findings.evidence: Bootstrap plan's Iron condition uses peakOpportunity > 0; its own contract leaves selected aircraft inputs, route and recovery unresolved.
findings.recommended_change: Compute live-registry transitive recipe/input budget against realized reachable resources and accepted workshop path; require deterministic alternatives for failure/recovery.
findings.acceptance: No Copper/Zinc/Petroleum/computing prerequisite before first flight; no lucky-roll hard gate; representative fresh player can obtain sufficient materials.

findings.title: Keep analytical design, mechanism proof and flyable aircraft distinct
findings.evidence: Aircraft ledger explicitly lacks trim, stability, pitch/roll and stable powered-flight qualification; #723-725 qualify route/client/seat stages.
findings.recommended_change: Close bounded runtime prerequisites, select the minimum practical first-flight capability, then qualify integrated control/handling; reuse retained craft if it satisfies approved product authority.
findings.acceptance: Actual-client control, passenger tracking, persistence and representative loaded flight pass; analytical proxies never become flight certification.

findings.title: Reconcile workshop status and complete usability only when needed
findings.evidence: Structure ledger says no human action pending and sequenced assembly unactivated; #734/#742 carry an explicit workshop human gate.
findings.recommended_change: Update the compact frontier; validate exact retained world-item process and take the bounded usability review when it is the chosen first-flight workshop.
findings.acceptance: No required item staging is physically impossible; real sequencing/repetition and recovery work; do not revive frozen #489 as production source.

findings.title: Prove hierarchy and combined-stack behavior before Bootstrap balancing
findings.evidence: #1063 explicitly inserts island -> cluster -> province -> coarse-world convergence.
findings.recommended_change: Build bounded representative fixtures at each scale; test cross-volume identity, routes, shared atmosphere, resource differentiation, persistence and streaming.
findings.acceptance: No major unresolved architecture/compatibility/performance unknown for the minimum intended production substrate; no infinite-world exhaustive matrix.

findings.title: Complete a real freight transaction through persistence and failures
findings.evidence: #466/#467 and Bootstrap contracts distinguish semantic freight from full physical runtime custody.
findings.recommended_change: Exercise producer stock, pickup/custody, physical cargo, delivery and exactly-once settlement; include restart, duplicate delivery and missing/destroyed cargo.
findings.acceptance: No duplicate goods/payment or lost canonical custody on interrupted transitions; an actual player can complete one loop.

findings.title: Persist the already-approved alpha scope without reopening it
findings.evidence: #1063 owner comment approves systems-complete/content-light alpha before content-heavy phases; active roadmap still requires Bellanca narrative and puts alpha after Phase 8.
findings.recommended_change: Adopt the decision in the next permitted source-bound reconciliation; distinguish fundamental civilization/freight systems from deferrable Guild/Bellanca content. Reconcile downstream contracts explicitly.
findings.acceptance: No new broad alpha scope question; Bellanca narrative/custom dragons/Lower Sea/bespoke dimensions do not silently block alpha; required core systems still do.

findings.title: Choose supported hardware/workloads before inventing performance pass values
findings.evidence: HS-11 remains open; #502/#560 track low-end scalability and lifecycle partitioning.
findings.recommended_change: Director chooses target environment and representative workload when Phase 2.5 baseline is ready; measure p50/p95/p99 tick/frame/chunk latency, memory and world growth on that workload.
findings.acceptance: Numeric budgets are approved and measured on declared hardware/settings; hosted runner results are not mislabeled as consumer-PC performance.

findings.title: Build one reproducible release candidate and supported dependency record
findings.evidence: README is explicitly pre-release; no stable player package is claimed; HS-10 covers redistribution policy.
findings.recommended_change: Create release BOM/artifact hashes, supported versions, install/update/uninstall and save compatibility policy, third-party notices and clean-machine/server smoke.
findings.acceptance: Exact distributable reproduces the tested stack and has reviewed redistribution provenance; no assumption Apache-2.0 covers third-party assets.

findings.title: Separate settled direction from remaining triggered choices
findings.evidence: HS-03/04 and platform gate have accepted dispositions; HS-07/08/10/11/12 still contain product decisions of different timing.
findings.recommended_change: Give each decision an immutable ID, trigger, affected nodes, resolved portion, remaining question and exact verdict evidence.
findings.acceptance: Only an actually blocking decision reaches the director; accepted scope is not reopened and unrelated work is not held.

findings.title: Refresh review artifacts to the current reset boundary
findings.evidence: REVIEW_ARTIFACTS lists failed key-2885 and DR-60 artifacts, while hydrology code has advanced; no current reset runtime review is registered.
findings.recommended_change: Retain historical verdicts but register the next real review with immutable source, dependency identities, specimen parameters, machine evidence and explicit material delta.
findings.acceptance: Owner can launch the exact qualified candidate and answer a short rubric; old acceptance cannot transfer to materially changed geometry automatically.

findings.title: Preserve milestone evidence beyond ephemeral artifacts
findings.evidence: DR-50 workflow retains artifacts for seven days; historical SHA/run references alone may outlive downloadable evidence.
findings.recommended_change: At milestone acceptance keep compact machine summaries/checksums and essential human packet in durable storage; leave raw bulk logs short-lived unless needed.
findings.acceptance: Every active acceptance claim remains inspectable after Actions retention; no blanket retention of all generated worlds.

findings.title: Narrow expensive validation fan-out by actual dependency surface
findings.evidence: DR-50 triggers on all skyforge-world/** and skyforge-neoforge-1211/** with 80-minute job/65-minute runtime limits. #1190 is a small neutral authorization test with broad suites.
findings.recommended_change: Audit measured job cost and affected paths; separate cheap acceptance from retained heavy characterization; preserve direct protection for runtime changes and known nondeterminism.
findings.acceptance: Canonical cheap gates always run; heavy rerun names a distinct risk; validate impact classification and fail-safe fallback in Actions before reducing triggers.

findings.title: Stop repeated CI polling and tiny repair loops
findings.evidence: Recent F4H/F4G history contains repeated formatting/literal repair commits; active hydrology task repeatedly sleeps/polls unchanged checks.
findings.recommended_change: Batch coherent edits and source review before expensive CI; use completion events/bounded status reads. Escalate repeated same-cause failures to diagnosis, not another tiny patch.
findings.acceptance: One criterion per tranche; each rerun has new code or evidence; no changed golden expectation without a semantic explanation.

findings.title: Strengthen semantic negative tests at authorization seams
findings.evidence: Current F4G corpus test uses CSV substring checks; #1190 positive factory coverage alone cannot prove correct runtime gate enforcement.
findings.recommended_change: Retain exact identity evidence but add targeted adversarial properties: wrong field, deferred water, legacy bypass, second volume, replay and mutation ordering.
findings.acceptance: Tests falsify the intended bad behaviors independently of the implementation; do not add a Cartesian runtime matrix.

findings.title: Verify effective branch/merge protection
findings.evidence: Repository ruleset listing returned []; classic main branch protection read returned 403. This does not establish that main is unprotected.
findings.recommended_change: Use administrator-visible policy export/read to confirm required checks, override rights, review rules and scope-specific auto-merge eligibility.
findings.acceptance: Current policy evidence demonstrates that machine-only merges cannot bypass required human/product gates; no new credentials are requested merely to read private data.

findings.title: Reduce concentrated complexity only at concrete maintenance pain
findings.evidence: Large NeoForge build script and controller modules coexist with many narrow semantic classes and historical evidence layers.
findings.recommended_change: Extract stable fixture/build plumbing and archive retired instructional entry points when touching them; profile authorization lookup before indexing it. Avoid a sweeping rewrite.
findings.acceptance: A measured maintenance/performance risk is reduced without semantic/hash drift; old evidence remains traceable and public contracts stable.

findings.title: Document Windows clone/path constraints
findings.evidence: Audit clone checkout failed on long class filenames in the long Codex artifact path; per-command core.longpaths=true completed it.
findings.recommended_change: Use an appropriately short inspection path or documented Git longpaths setup; distinguish a real checkout from a source copy with unrelated .git metadata.
findings.acceptance: Supported Windows onboarding produces a complete tree and known origin/SHA; no deletion or replacement of existing local work.

findings.title: Correct public capability and runtime summaries
findings.evidence: README says MUS-0002/C20/frontier #284; runtime architecture says frontier #194 and Sep-06; current main is much later.
findings.recommended_change: Refresh current summaries from accepted boundaries, preserve historical reviews and link the one current capability registry.
findings.acceptance: README, runtime overview and presentation make the same qualified claims; reset hydrology is not advertised as accepted production water.

findings.title: Preserve source identity; add playback/mastering only for a concrete release need
findings.evidence: MUS-0005 reference render accepted; Track 00/06 exact-session provenance caveats are explicitly nonblocking; final GAME/OST masters are not accepted.
findings.recommended_change: Preserve original sources/checksums; decide static versus adaptive alpha playback at HS-12 trigger; create only required mastered cues and licensing/backup records.
findings.acceptance: No reconstruction presented as recovered source; human listening approves new deliverables; old recovery gate is not reopened.

findings.title: Show the integrated product and its limits
findings.evidence: Presentation has accepted narrative/claim architecture but artifacts/ledgers lag current work.
findings.recommended_change: Build the short demo from accepted combined-stack candidate, with exact claim-to-scene evidence; distinguish foundation, experimental hydrology and roadmap.
findings.acceptance: Capture/runtime/audio provenance is recorded; director judges comprehension, and no scene implies a capability missing from the tested stack.

findings.title: Measure useful progress using current compact telemetry
findings.evidence: Efficiency baseline is Sep-14 (42 workflow files) while baseline now has 73; Audit state is an extended legacy incident log.
findings.recommended_change: Record accepted milestones, critical-path age, blocked reason, CI retries/cost and human gate material delta; keep platform reliability work closed absent a concrete failure.
findings.acceptance: One compact current status plus immutable history; no platform expansion just to make dashboards richer.

findings.title: Keep post-alpha ideas reachable without making them dispatchable
findings.evidence: Roadmap includes regional economy, mature industry/computing, ecology/adventure, End/high sky and optional Lower Sea/second backend; #1063 defers bespoke breadth.
findings.recommended_change: Maintain condition-triggered expansion nodes with explicit first consumer and decision gate; do not give broad future nodes automatic worker authority.
findings.acceptance: Each future path has dependencies and an entry gate; no civilization/physics/compiler abstraction is added without a present consumer.

findings.title: Adopt evidence-bearing completion and bounded handoffs
findings.evidence: Several current seams are merged but not exercised in production; preserved/closed PRs and local edits can be mistaken for accepted milestones.
findings.recommended_change: Require source identity, criterion-level machine results, human verdict where applicable, dependency-surface portability and explicit successor; cap open-ended tranche extension.
findings.acceptance: Merge, issue closure, all-rejected corpus, local consistency check or elapsed waiting never alone marks a product node complete.
